occurrences.englishText: He struck them hip and thigh with a great slaughter; and he went down and lived in the cave in Etam’s rock.
Then three thousand men of Judah went down to the cave in Etam’s rock, and said to Samson, “Don’t you know that the Philistines are rulers over us? What then is this that you have done to us?”
These were the sons of the father of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. The name of their sister was Hazzelelponi.
Their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan, five cities;
